Implemented:
- `VersionInfo.to_dict()` returns all five named version parts.
- `VersionInfo.__getitem__` supports integer indices, negative indices, and slices using tuple semantics.
- Preserved existing private accessors and added method documentation.
- Created `STATUS.json` with confidence estimates.

Validation: all 175 existing tests passed, along with doctests and direct accessor/indexing checks. No tests or configuration files were changed.
